behavior: Validates operator/location UUIDs and canonical YYYY-MM-DD periods before opening the report-data connection; OIDC session and route-grant authorization is a separate Gateway check.
Establishes database-signed operator tenant context before invoking any report generator.
Runs the existing 14-section report in a read-only transaction with an eight-second statement timeout and a two-second lock timeout.
Returns no-store responses and exposes no default grant to DAO, guild, liquidity-provider, or community audiences.
Rejects generated JSON payloads larger than 512 KiB and does not persist, verify, publish, or attest reports.
